# cloptima_llm_edge_instance (Resource)

Registers a Cloptima edge gateway instance that runs in your own environment and issues its edge PAT. Every attribute change replaces the instance and issues a new edge PAT. An instance revoked outside Terraform is recreated on the next apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloptima_llm_edge_instance" "vpc_prod" {
  name                   = "us-east-1-k8s-edge-cluster"
  environment            = "prod"
  region                 = "us-east-1"
  deployment_type        = "kubernetes"
  lease_duration_seconds = 86400 # 24 hours

  metadata = jsonencode({
    cluster_name = "prod-core-k8s"
    vpc_id       = "vpc-0123456789abcdef0"
  })
}

# The edge bootstrap PAT is returned once upon creation to initialize the edge pod
output "edge_instance_bootstrap_pat" {
  value     = cloptima_llm_edge_instance.vpc_prod.edge_pat
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name for this edge instance, 3 to 128 characters.

### Optional

- `deployment_type` (String) Deployment type: kubernetes, docker_compose, ecs, vm, local, or other. Defaults to kubernetes.
- `environment` (String) Environment: dev, staging, prod, or sandbox. Defaults to prod.
- `lease_duration_seconds` (Number) Lease duration in seconds, from 3600 (1 hour) to 2592000 (30 days). Defaults to 1209600 (14 days).
- `metadata` (String) Optional metadata for the edge instance, as a JSON object.
- `region` (String) Region where this edge instance runs.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `customer_id` (String) Owning customer ID.
- `edge_pat` (String, Sensitive) Edge PAT the edge gateway uses to authenticate with Cloptima. Available only in the state of the apply that created the instance; it is not recovered on import.
- `id` (String) Edge instance ID.
- `lease_expires_at` (String) Timestamp when the current lease expires.
- `status` (String) Edge instance status: pending until the edge gateway registers, then active.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
